notes:
FOLLOW-UP (2026-09-12, later same day): the two engine gaps this card's own migration note documented below (no persistent 'attacked this turn' condition; no play-from-library-top Effect kind) are now CLOSED for real — see ENGINE_GAPS.md gap #16. The play-from-library fact now has real trace evidence; `isLunarWhalePlayFromLibraryFact` was removed from verify-synergy.mjs (replaced by a real `producedEvents` 'play' case). `scenarios.ts` now runs a real engine-piloted playthrough (crew → attack → play a real card off the top of the library). The `pilotActivate`-can't-crew gap (knownGaps #4 below) is also closed — `pilotActivate` now takes a real `crewedBy` param. Original migration note (now partially superseded) preserved below for history.

Migrated to unified Fact model (2026-09-12). 5 source + 1 sink fact, all annotated (added to ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS).

Flying — bare printed keyword, no fact (2026-09-12 standing rule, SYNERGY_DESIGN.md) — same treatment Cargo Ship's own Flying/Vigilance already get.

"You may look at the top card of your library any time." — no fact authored. Pure information-only static permission: nothing changes, nothing moves, no occurrence for a sink to consume. Checked the pool: nothing wants "controller has looked at their own library top." Same "nothing real to anchor a state change to" reasoning that got Summon: Bahamut's own self-battlefield deleted outright.

"As long as The Lunar Whale attacked this turn, you may play the top card of your library." — real, genuine attack-conditional card-advantage engine, and a real DOUBLE engine gap, both checked directly (not assumed): (1) no persistent "attacked this turn" condition anywhere on RealCard/GameState (engine.ts's own GameEngine.attackers is a fresh per-combat list, never consulted later in the turn as a per-permanent condition); (2) no Effect kind in card.ts lets a card "play" (CR 601/305's umbrella term — cast or land-drop, whichever the top card's own type is) a card straight off the library — dig only ever moves to hand/bottom, never resolves a cast/land-drop. The Regalia (fin/58) hit an adjacent version of this same gap. Modeled anyway as a real fact — new event:'play' vocabulary, from:'Library' (the one guaranteed part of the act; destination genuinely varies — Battlefield for a land, the deliberately-invisible Stack for anything cast — same double reasoning self-enters's own omitted zoneFrom already uses), exempted via new isLunarWhalePlayFromLibraryFact (scripts/verify-synergy.mjs) since zero trace evidence is achievable at all. New ENGINE_GAPS.md entry (#15) documents both halves. Traveling Chocobo (fin/158, unmigrated) carries the identical clause and can reuse this vocabulary/exemption once migrated.

Crew 1 — reused the exact real crewCost+activationCost+effects:[animate] machinery Cargo Ship/Magitek Armor/The Prima Vista already established (ENGINE_GAPS.md's Crew N entry, CLOSED). event:'crew' + event:'grantType' (Creature, untilEndOfTurn) SOURCE facts get real trace evidence for free via the existing producedEvents 'activate'/'animate' cases (auto-fired by harness.ts's own activationCost lifecycle, no sequence needed — this card has no separate named ability, unlike Cargo Ship's mana ability). self-cast/self-enters baseline facts covered by the existing structural isActivationCostPermanentBaselineFact exemption; the crew-cost creature-want sink covered by the existing structural isCrewCostCreatureWant exemption — neither needed new code, both already generalize past card name.

Removed the old v1 facts entirely (a presence-shaped {zone:'Graveyard', subject:'self'} SOURCE and a bare {event:'dies', target:'self'} — both a real violation of the standing 'no presence in sources, only zone movements' rule, same class as Summon: Bahamut's own deleted self-battlefield; neither had any annotation basis either). Removed CardDefinition.staticAbilities entirely (the two static-text lines now live only as definition.ts comments, matching Cargo Ship's own treatment of its bare-keyword lines) — checked it isn't consumed by anything relevant post-migration (only legacy synergyTags()/manaAbilityColorFromStaticText, neither applicable here).

One scenario (per the task's own '1 default, real basic function' instruction), unchanged from before migration: {result:'becomes an artifact creature (crewed)', you:{creaturesCount:1}} — real auto-fired Crew 1 activation + animate, same minimal shape Cargo Ship/Magitek Armor's own crew probe uses. Did NOT attempt a full engine-piloted attack declaration (engine-trace.ts's pilotActivate calls activateAbility with no crewedBy argument at all, so it cannot legally activate a crewCost card at all today — a real, new gap distinct from the already-documented isCrewCostCreatureWant one; adding a pilotCrew helper is real, separate, cross-cutting engine-trace.ts work, out of scope for a single-card fact migration, same 'documented, not fixed' boundary Cargo Ship's own crewedBy-simulation gap already draws) — so 'attacked' evidence for the play-from-library fact was never achievable in this pass regardless of the Effect-kind gap above.

verify-synergy.mjs the-lunar-whale: 0 hard failures, 1 accepted soft note (trace has legendRule ... no matching declared produce — same, already-accepted note The Prima Vista's own real synergy.json produces; Legendary Vehicles don't declare a self-dies fact for the legend rule scenario keywordScenarios() auto-adds, checked against Ashe/The Prima Vista as precedent, not a regression). Full pool (317 checked): 9 hard failures (cargo-ship, cecil-dark-knight-cecil-redeemed-paladin, dragoon-s-wyvern, ice-flan, il-mheg-pixie, stiltzkin-moogle-merchant, the-wind-crystal, white-auracite, zack-fair) — confirmed NOT caused by this task (none reference the-lunar-whale, concurrent sessions were actively editing annotation-coverage.mjs/cargo-ship during this pass, confirmed via git status timing). npx vitest run functional-model: 238/238.

find-synergies.mjs diff (isolated: old synergy.json swapped in, pool-wide run, filtered to 'Lunar Whale' lines, then restored and re-run — not a stale HEAD diff, working tree has diverged too far across concurrent sessions for that to isolate cleanly): before 20 lines (17 illegitimate 'Lunar Whale --[graveyard presence]-->X' + 3 'Lunar Whale --[dying]-->X', all correctly removed per the no-presence-shaped-source rule and the dropped tautological dies fact); after 150 lines (112 real 'X --[battlefield presence/enters the battlefield]--> Lunar Whale' via the new crew-cost creature-want sink matching every unconstrained creature-presence/entersBattlefield producer in the pool, 38 real 'Lunar Whale --[enters the battlefield]-->X' via self-cast/self-enters matching Battlefield/entersBattlefield-shaped sinks pool-wide). Zero matches yet for crew/grantType/play (new vocabulary, no consumer sink exists today) — same 'vocabulary now real, matched later' shape pump/grantType promotions already established. Net well-understood, same shape as Magitek Armor's own 12->152 and Cargo Ship's own 35->145 migration diffs.
knownGaps: "You may look at the top card of your library any time." has no fact at all — pure information-only static permission, nothing for a sink to consume, no state change.

CLOSED (2026-09-12, later same day): "As long as The Lunar Whale attacked this turn, you may play the top card of your library." now has real trace evidence — see ENGINE_GAPS.md gap #16. Real 'attacked this turn' flag + real playFromLibraryTop Effect kind now exist.

animate/LayerSet tracks no duration (layers.ts's documented scope, pre-existing, not new to this pass) — a crewed Lunar Whale becomes a creature PERMANENTLY in this model rather than 'until end of turn'.
CLOSED (2026-09-12, later same day): engine-trace.ts's pilotActivate now takes a real crewedBy param and can legally crew a crewCost card.

engine.ts's canActivateAbility/activateAbility gate ANY named-ability activation through the crewCost branch whenever card.crewCost is set (ENGINE_GAPS.md's Crew N entry) — doesn't affect this card (only one ability), documented for completeness.

The 'As long as The Lunar Whale attacked this turn,' condition clause has no structured representation anywhere — the CardDefinition's own `triggers:[{name:'playFromLibraryTop',...}]` entry has no `on`/condition field at all (it's a manually-pilotFireTrigger-invoked bundle, not a real auto-firing Trigger), so this gating condition lives only in comments/pilot-script discipline, never a typed field a future definition-path span could point at. `playFromLibraryTop-effect-structural.ts`'s own fixed literal-clause template deliberately only anchors the guaranteed 'you may play the top card of your library' clause, never this condition prefix, for the same reason.

annotatedNonFactSpans.note: "You may look at the top card of your library any time." — pure information-only static permission (see this card's own knownGaps entry and definition.ts comment): nothing changes, nothing moves, no occurrence any sink could consume.

"As long as The Lunar Whale attacked this turn," — a real, engine-enforced gating condition (RealCard.attackedThisTurn, engine.ts's declareAttackers/state.clearAttackedThisTurn), but not represented by any typed field on this card's own `triggers` entry (a manually-invoked named-effect bundle, not an auto-firing CR 603 Trigger with a condition field) — see this card's own knownGaps entry for the full reasoning. The effect clause itself ('you may play the top card of your library') IS backed by a real Fact (playFromLibraryTop-effect-structural.ts); only this condition prefix is fact-less.
